notes.title: How the producer is doing
notes.content:
Hello~♥
I would like to thank everyone who enjoys this work, and I would like to share a brief update.

[hr][/hr]
[b]1. Recently, the RPGMaker community in Korea drew a game fan art, so I'm sharing it with you.[/b]
[list]
[*]"샤인" drew this. It's Yuri who shines her eyes while looking at the food Ragnar and Bonnie made.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/9a47a0755aa6c740128f474222448d1a77f0c090.png[/img]
[*]"바이러스" also drew Yuri, the main character. She's famous for creating a game called 'Period Survival'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/a69d132deae68e439789530ef418efe42b5b745c.png[/img]
[*]'루카' drew Lane, a Suin tribe, in the shape of a fox.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/5125bd83e087052ea96215971457de929a5b4ce1.jpg[/img]
[*]'나브' drw a picture of Yuri holding the final boss with a flame bomb. "Revolution is explosion!" she says.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/62f61ca0895edb8e687ff97ea3b94531a01b6b47.png[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[b]2. We are planning to participate in the spring sale. [/b]
[list]
[*]Spring is the season when my family picked up the cat in the game, 'Bomi'
[*]Bomi has been our joy for a long time. But last summer, she crossed the rainbow bridge because of a mammary gland tumor.
[*]At that time, I thought I wanted to melt my memories with Bomi into the game. So I worked on it, and that's how this was born.
[*]So please shut up and look at the pictures of my cat, please!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/366118c0ccc786feec0031eb3bd28f71899f730b.jpg[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[b]3. 3. I participated in the "1 Chicken Alman Tool Game Jam 2024" competition with a piece called "태엽시계의 왕좌"[/b]
[list]
[*]This work is a collaboration by Team Eclipse, free of charge.We only support Korean.
[*]As of 2024.3.2, you can get it from the following Google Drive and try it.
[*][url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SK9Mti979ZF4JSiyNXGPZ4M36IBIyrpM/view?usp=sharing]https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SK9Mti979ZF4JSiyNXGPZ4M36IBIyrpM/view?usp=sharing[/url]
[*]From March 10, 2024, you can search for "태엽시계의 왕좌" on Stove Indy and enjoy it.
[*][url=https://store.onstove.com/ko]https://store.onstove.com/ko[/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/9429c85a63b34b935072954c0931159eb7779bb4.png[/img]
[/list]

[hr][/hr]
[b]4. We started developing the next piece.[/b]
[*]The next piece will be the backstory that follows this game.
[*]It will be released around 2024.August.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44537869/e7f5da6b296d047fd9dc8e4e50eaed7ec5b2933b.png[/img]

[hr][/hr]
Thank you for reading it. 

I would like to thank you again for your love and love of "Girl Travels Forest of Dreams." 

It's really, really late, but happy new year~♥
